title: Record baseline verification and repository state
description: Run the exact existing baseline commands from the repository root and save sanitized results as the before-state for PRD acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: `npm run version:check`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `TURBO_DISABLE=true npx tsx scripts/test-optimizations.ts`, and `TURBO_DISABLE=true npm run build` are each invoked from `xistance-panel/`
The sanitized result records exit code, test counts, warnings, and environment gaps
No output contains passwords, tokens, cookies, private keys, or database contents
The baseline is not represented as passing if any command failed

steps.details: Execute `npm run version:check` and capture its exit code and output; do not alter version files.
Execute `npm run lint` and capture warnings/errors separately from the exit code.
Execute `npm run typecheck` and capture the first actionable failure if any.
Execute `TURBO_DISABLE=true npx tsx scripts/test-optimizations.ts`; record passed/failed counts and failing test names only.
Execute `TURBO_DISABLE=true npm run build`; record success, warnings, and route/build output without copying source paths containing secrets.
Create `.agent/evidence/baseline.md` with commands, exit codes, sanitized results, host/tool versions, and unresolved gaps. Keep every task pass flag false until evidence is reviewed.

technicalNotes: Evidence: `.agent/evidence/baseline.md` records the sanitized repository, toolchain, and environment state.
Re-verified 2026-09-25: version:check, lint, typecheck, the 77-test optimization harness, production build, and shell syntax all exited 0.
The build warning set is recorded separately; the first Windows Prisma EPERM was traced to a stale dev process and resolved without changing application code.
The baseline is not a release acceptance result: Docker daemon, architecture-specific artifacts, browser suite evidence, and real Ubuntu VPS evidence remain separate gates.
No secret values, environment-file values, database contents, cookies, tokens, or private keys were recorded.
